verdicts.decision_note: The client leaves unresolved whether Thrive licensing requires its removal, materially affecting the site's page-builder configuration.
The client establishes the current and replacement-site page-builder configuration and identifies Elementor as the migration target for landing and new pages; no prior value keys require removal.
The message describes builder usage and possible migration but does not resolve whether or when Thrive must be removed, so it does not support RESUME.
The freelancer identifies a concrete visual-breakage risk and recommends delaying full Thrive removal, but the client has not confirmed that lifecycle decision.
